summary: The University of Strathclyde in Glasgow gives a number of £10,000 scholarships to international (non-EU) students starting a full-time taught master's in its Faculty of Humanities & Social Sciences in January 2027. There is no form: every eligible offer holder is considered automatically. The deadline is 30 November 2026.
meta_description: Strathclyde's Dean's International Excellence Scholarship takes £10,000 off a January 2027 humanities or social sciences master's. Deadline 30 November 2026.
covers: £10,000 towards tuition fees for one year of study.
eligibility: International (non-EU) fee status, paying your own fees.

An offer for a full-time taught master's in the Faculty of Humanities & Social Sciences starting in January 2027, in subjects such as education, English, history, international relations, journalism, languages, law, politics, psychology and social policy.
Online and blended programmes, PG Diplomas, PG Certificates, the PGDE and the MSW Social Work are not eligible.
Awarded on merit: excellent academic results plus relevant extra-curricular or professional experience.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible January 2027 master's at Strathclyde.
There is no separate scholarship application: every eligible international offer holder is considered automatically.
The deadline is 30 November 2026. The faculty's decision is final.
watch_out: You can hold only one Strathclyde scholarship per academic year.
The award is lost if you defer to a later year or change programme or faculty after enrolling.
Holders are expected to take part in student ambassador activities.
This round is for January 2027 starts only.

faq.q: Do I need to apply for the Strathclyde Dean's International Excellence Scholarship?
faq.a: No. Every eligible international offer holder for a January 2027 Humanities & Social Sciences master's is considered automatically.
£10,000 towards tuition fees for one year.
